page_title: PSG 3-3 STR | PSG v Strasbourg 17/10/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's the end of the match.
90+6' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (PSG) picks up a pass and tries his luck from mid-range towards the bottom right corner, but Mike Penders is equal to it and makes an easy save.
90+5' Quentin Ndjantou (PSG) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
90+5' Lucas Hogsberg (Strasbourg) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
90+3' Quentin Ndjantou (PSG) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Clement Turpin no option but to blow his whistle.
90+2' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (PSG) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates.
90+1' Liam Rosenior is forced to make a change. Ismael Doukoure (Strasbourg) is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Rafael Luis.
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.
90' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Senny Mayulu as he is replaced by Nuno Mendes (PSG).
89' Willian Pacho (PSG) collects a sweet pass on the edge of the box and in one movement smashes a shot in on goal, but it balloons high over the bar.
87' PSG seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
84' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (PSG) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and bends his effort inches wide of the left post.
79' 3 - 3 Senny Mayulu (PSG) gets to a rebound inside the six-yard box and produces a header. He manages to put the ball inside the left post, and thus alter the score to 3:3.
78' Goncalo Ramos (PSG) makes a terrific run to get on the end of the free kick and powers a header just over the bar from close in.
74' Luis Enrique (PSG) goes into the referee's book. Yellow card.
74' Kang-In Lee (PSG) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
73' Here's the change. Diego Moreira leaves the pitch and Martial Godo (Strasbourg) comes on as a substitute.
72' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (PSG) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.

72' Goncalo Ramos (PSG) finds himself some space inside the box, collects a rebound and sends an effort in on goal. Mike Penders pulls off a fantastic reflex save to stop the ball going inside the right-hand post. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to PSG.
72' Kang-In Lee (PSG) fires a brilliant shot from the edge of the box, but the effort rattles the right post! It could have been a superb goal.
70' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Felix Lemarechal (Strasbourg).
65' Liam Rosenior has decided to make a change. Felix Lemarechal (Strasbourg) replaces Julio Enciso.
65' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Samir El Mourabet trots off the pitch and is replaced by Andrew Omobamidele (Strasbourg).
64' Kang-In Lee (PSG) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
62' Kang-In Lee (PSG) takes the corner but it's cleared.
61' Luis Enrique has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Khvicha Kvaratskhelia replacing Bradley Barcola (PSG).
61' Here is a change. Desire Doue is going off and Luis Enrique gives the last tactical orders to Quentin Ndjantou (PSG).
61' The referee signals a substitution. Willian Pacho (PSG) is brought on as a substitute for Lucas Beraldo.
60' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Lucas Hernandez (PSG) was quite harsh and Clement Turpin didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
58' 2 - 3 Goal! Goncalo Ramos (PSG) puts the ball into the bottom left corner past the outstretched arm of Mike Penders.
57' Goncalo Ramos (PSG) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
56' Mike Penders (Strasbourg) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
56' Mike Penders (Strasbourg) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Clement Turpin blows for a foul. PENALTY to PSG! Great chance to score.
53' Goncalo Ramos (PSG) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the roof of the net, but Mike Penders was alert and the score remains the same.
51' Dangerous play by Quentin Ndjantou (PSG). Clement Turpin blows his whistle for a foul.

49' 1 - 3 It's in the back of the net! Superb finishing from Joaquin Panichelli (Strasbourg). Diego Moreira plays a fantastic through ball and finds Joaquin Panichelli (Strasbourg), who reacts quickly to get in front of the goalkeeper and fire a close-range shot into the left side of the goal. It's now 1:3.
47' Great touch by Julio Enciso (Strasbourg) as he receives a precise pass deep inside the box and rips a shot goalwards, but the keeper pulls off an amazing save!
46' The whistle blows and Clement Turpin starts the second half.
45+2' The match has reached half-time.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
44' Clement Turpin interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Guela Doue (Strasbourg).

41' 1 - 2 Diego Moreira (Strasbourg) latches on to a precise pass deep inside the box from Valentin Barco, and he beats the goalkeeper with a low accurate shot into the bottom left corner. He makes it 1:2.
40' 72:28 – the ratio of ball possession.
38' It's a nice effort by Julio Enciso (Strasbourg) from the edge of the box, but it's low towards the middle of the goal and straight down the throat of Lucas Chevalier. Easy save.
37' Julio Enciso (Strasbourg) makes space inside the box for a shot, but his effort goes just wide of the right post.
35' The free kick from Desire Doue (PSG) failed to provide any scoring opportunity, as one of the defenders did a good job and knocked it out.

34' Julio Enciso (Strasbourg) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Clement Turpin with no other option than to blow for a foul. It's a free kick to PSG, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
34' Desire Doue (PSG) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.

26' 1 - 1 Guela Doue sends a superb cross into the box. Joaquin Panichelli (Strasbourg) latches on to it and from close range plants a header inside the right post, leaving Lucas Chevalier beaten. He displayed his eye for goal there - excellent finish. The score is 1:1.
25' My Gran could have done better! Senny Mayulu (PSG) got himself in a great position on the edge of the box after a pass, but put his shot well wide of the left post.
23' Bradley Barcola (PSG) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the right side of the goal, but Mike Penders has it covered and makes a comfortable save.
22' Joaquin Panichelli (Strasbourg) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him.
21' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Warren Zaire-Emery (PSG), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
18' A pass lands at the feet of Julio Enciso (Strasbourg) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender.

17' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. PSG are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
11' Strasbourg force their opponents to concede a corner.
11' Joaquin Panichelli (Strasbourg) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a low drive towards the middle of the net, but Lucas Chevalier is alert and denies him.
6' 1 - 0 Fantastic team goal! Bradley Barcola (PSG) was set free in the area by Desire Doue and fired past Mike Penders. 1:0.
5' Senny Mayulu (PSG) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
4' PSG take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

3' Desire Doue (PSG) receives a clever pass and shoots from mid-range. His shot looks like it's going in the bottom right corner, but Mike Penders has other ideas and makes a brilliant save. PSG have been awarded a corner kick.
2' Joaquin Panichelli (Strasbourg) fouls an opponent during an attacking move.
2' Clement Turpin has a clear sight and sees a foul from Ibrahim Mbaye (PSG).
2' Guela Doue (Strasbourg) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out and the match is about to start. PSG will have the kick-off.
Clement Turpin will referee today's match.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
